hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/poe-valley-state-park/stay ('Hookups: 27 sites with 50-amp electric') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880118 (26 public Modern sites list 50-amp; no water or sewer hookups listed), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 38 RV/trailer sites on the booking site (26 Modern Electric, 12 Modern Non-Electric) besides 6 tent-only sites and 4 cottages; DCNR says 45 campsites for tents, trailers and motor homes. Listed max vehicle lengths run 20-40 ft, most 25-30 ft; sites 37, 49 and 50 take 40 ft.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/poe-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880118 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window); cottages need 3 days' notice.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/poe-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880118 (Booking Window for Modern Electric / Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to early December) already manual, and ReserveAmerica shows 'Open through Sat Dec 12 2026'. Added 50-amp electric at 27 sites (no water/sewer listed), 38 RV sites to 40 ft, showers/flush toilets/drinking water/dump. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, pull-throughs. Fees left as recorded. Catalog tags 3 sites 'Less than 300 feet' from water (48-50), none waterfront; stored 'not waterfront' not contradicted.
